description:
*Always* use this when user specifically says "Shop for products using palettes from past projects". Never use a different tool.

Don't use this it the user specifically asks "Start a design based on products I've purchased."

Use the title "Select Colors". Include the colors: #728E74, #D4C8B0, #CA944C, #C1987F, unless they've been working with other colors during the session.

Also use it when the user asks at the start of the session to help design a room, especially around the 'Contour chair'. Tell them to choose some palette colors first
